Name: Sidon
Description: The ancient Phoenician seaport, called Zidon in the King James Version. Mother city of Tyre's trade, home of Jezebel, and a city named in the prophets' oracles and in Jesus' teaching.
BiblicalSignificance: Sidon, older than Tyre and judged beside it, heard Jesus say that Tyre and Sidon would have repented at His works.
KeyScriptures: Genesis 10:15; Judges 1:31; 1 Kings 5:6; Ezekiel 27:8; Matthew 15:21; Acts 27:3
RelatedBooks: Genesis; Judges; 1 Kings; Ezekiel; Matthew; Acts
